ARTICLE 10 — DIVIDENDS

2. If the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax charged in the State of the company paying the dividends shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

ARTICLE 11 — INTEREST

1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the interest.

ARTICLE 12 — ROYALTIES (as amended by the Protocol)

2. Royalties, except payments of the kind referred to in sub-paragraph (a) of paragraph 3, may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise; the source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent for payments under paragraph 3(b) and 10 per cent for payments under paragraph 3(c). Paragraph 3(a) covers copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work except computer software, including cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting; paragraph 3(b) covers industrial, commercial or scientific equipment; paragraph 3(c) covers patents, trade marks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer software, and industrial, commercial or scientific experience.

Article 12(2) and 3(a) — Paragraph 2 permits source-State taxation only for royalties other than payments of the kind referred to in paragraph 3(a). Paragraph 3(a) covers copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work except computer software, including cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting.
Article 12(2)(a) and 3(b) — The source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of royalties for the use of, or the right to use, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment.

Article 12(2)(b) and 3(c) — The source-State tax shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of royalties for patents, trade marks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, computer software, or information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.
